title: KAITO — A Reassuring Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Morinomiya Revue - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I came to see how Emu's doing, but...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... What kinds of shows would make the audience want to come back...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, I still think ticket prices are the problem...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How do we get them to return...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She seems to be doing her best...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I have a feeling that she'll be fine now.
I shouldn't interrupt her, so I'll leave her alone.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I know...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Since I'm here, I'll try seeing how Tsukasa and the others are doing.)
Morinomiya Music Academy - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hnng...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, take a look! I've become this flexible!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, that's impressive.
Congratulations, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Despite initially struggling with my flexibility, training daily has allowed me to overcome that! Even I'm amazed at how limber I've become!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They appear to be stretching together.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (After they first experienced lessons at Morinomiya, they mentioned needing to improve their flexibility...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And they're doing their best to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Next, let's see how Nene's doing...)
Morinomiya Music Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Where could Nene be...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, it looks like she's working. I'm seeing an assortment of costumes on that table.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She must be touching them up for that show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you here to check up on me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<I became a little curious.
You're helping get things ready for the quarterly performance, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and helping out behind the scenes has been pretty fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Unlike most student productions, Morinomiya is equipped with professional-quality stuff.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It is nice that you're getting this sort of experience.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, and everyone's been teaching me how to use anything that looks unfamiliar. I've really been learning a lot.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You and the others are all working so hard.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me and the others?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I went over to see what Tsukasa and Rui were doing before coming here. They were both working very hard on becoming more flexible.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Then, did you also go see Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've kinda been wondering what she's doing since she's been so busy lately. I figure studying management can't be easy, so...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, well...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Emu appeared to be doing everything she can to solve her current problem.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess I don't need to worry as long as you're keeping an eye on her, KAITO. Tsukasa and Rui also said something similar about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Oh, they did...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. The fact that she isn't telling us much probably means that she wants to solve the problem on her own.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know that feeling all too well, so I plan on respecting her wishes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You must believe in her quite a bit.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, we've been friends for a while now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I feel the same way as you, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I also believe that her hard work will end up paying off.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I can just tell.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Let's keep believing in her and wait for the good news.>
